title: Draft Fuyutsuki's voice and sample entries

acceptance: Agent writes the voice description in its own words and four sample entries (Italian and English) showing a range: straight immersive and light humour in docs/design/chronicle-eva-voice.md: immersive in-world narration, warm and allowed to be funny, never a cold technical log; a darker undertone optional; only invented recorded facts with their sources; no quotation or reproduction of any existing script or dialogue
